tools.name: get_health
tools.description: Health check for Birthday Gift Finder. Returns ok, storage, defaultDomain (amazon.se), catalogs for amazon.se and amazon.com with their tracking tags, and marketplaces[]. Use this first. OpenAPI: getHealth.

tools.name: list_marketplaces
tools.description: List supported Amazon storefronts. amazon.com (US) and amazon.se have hand-picked catalogs with /dp links. Pass marketplace on search/catalog/resolve when you know the user's store; otherwise en-US requests get amazon.com and everything else amazon.se.

tools.name: search_gifts
tools.description: Search birthday gifts on the user's Amazon storefront. Pass marketplace=amazon.com for US shoppers (English search), amazon.se for Sweden. Returns search links plus hand-picked catalogMatches with /dp links. OpenAPI: searchAmazon.

tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: Paginated hand-picked birthday gifts with /dp buyUrls. marketplace=amazon.com returns the US catalog (English, USD or no price, tag sw-fodelsedag-20); amazon.se the Swedish one (tag sw-fodelsedag-21). OpenAPI: getCatalog.

tools.name: resolve_product
tools.description: Resolve an ASIN, pasted Amazon /dp/ URL, or keywords to a buyUrl on amazon.com or amazon.se (tagged for both). Pass marketplace when known. OpenAPI: resolveProduct.

tools.name: create_wishlist
tools.description: Create a birthday gift wishlist. Returns id, editToken, ownerUrl, shopUrl, wishlist, storage. Save editToken for add_wishlist_item. OpenAPI: createWishlist.

tools.name: create_and_fill
tools.description: One call: create a curated birthday gift wishlist and return shopUrl (share link) + ownerUrl. Preferred agent path: create a wishlist and add ASINs / keywords / search queries in one call. OpenAPI: agentCreateAndFill.

tools.name: get_wishlist
tools.description: Fetch a wishlist by id. Returns wishlist items with buyUrl/linkType when available, plus ownerUrl and shopUrl. OpenAPI: getWishlist.

tools.name: add_wishlist_item
tools.description: Add an item to a wishlist. Requires editToken from create. OpenAPI: addWishlistItem.
